sections.content: A lo largo del día orders daily activity across a stretch of time; a raíz de and como consecuencia de both introduce a cause, with como consecuencia de leaning slightly more formal and conclusive. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: A raíz de las Leyes de Indias, promulgadas en 1573, prácticamente todas las nuevas ciudades siguieron el mismo patrón.
items.english: As a result of the Laws of the Indies, issued in 1573, practically every new city followed the same pattern.

items.spanish: A lo largo del día, esa plaza y sus alrededores se llenaban de actividad.
items.english: Throughout the day, that plaza and its surroundings filled with activity.

items.spanish: Como consecuencia de esa actividad constante, la plaza funcionaba como el verdadero centro social de la ciudad.
items.english: As a consequence of that constant activity, the plaza functioned as the city's true social center.

items.spanish: La vida cotidiana colonial, a raíz de sus propias tensiones de género, de clase y de costumbre, generaba conflictos tan reales como los grandes debates políticos.
items.english: Colonial daily life, due to its own tensions of gender, class and custom, generated conflicts as real as the great political debates.

sections.content: A lo largo del día is purely about time passing, not cause — don't confuse it with a raíz de, which always signals "and because of this, something changed." Como consecuencia de works almost interchangeably with a raíz de, but reads slightly more like a formal conclusion than an ongoing ripple effect.
